metadata.execution: signal at close; trade at next trading-day open
constraints: skip entry when next open is at estimated up-limit
delay exit when next open is at estimated down-limit
metadata.sample_limitation: Point-in-time deterministic samples from the then-current CSI 300 and CSI 500 constituents reduce, but do not eliminate, index-selection and survivorship bias. Results are an engineering baseline, not proof of alpha.
